description: Monthly scan of new AI tools, models, and platforms relevant to gestoria automation
prompt: Research the latest AI tools and platforms for business automation, focusing on: 1) New AI models released this month 2) Automation tools for SMEs 3) Fiscal/accounting AI innovations 4) Google AI ecosystem updates 5) Open-source AI tools. Summarize key findings with actionable insights for AIGestion.

description: Monthly analysis of competing AI platforms for gestorias and SMEs
prompt: Analyze competitors in the AI-for-business-automation space: 1) What features do they offer? 2) Pricing comparison 3) What are users saying (reviews, complaints)? 4) Gaps we can exploit 5) Marketing strategies that work. Focus on Spanish/European market.

description: Monthly scan of emerging technologies AIGestion could adopt
prompt: Research emerging technologies relevant to AIGestion: 1) New web standards (WebMCP, built-in AI, etc.) 2) Agent frameworks 3) No-code/low-code platforms 4) Blockchain/Web3 for business 5) Voice AI and multimodal interfaces. Rate each by: relevance, maturity, free-tier availability, and implementation effort.

description: Monthly synthesis of user feedback, support tickets, and feature requests
prompt: Synthesize user feedback patterns for AIGestion: 1) Common pain points 2) Most requested features 3) Usability issues 4) Performance complaints 5) Success stories. Generate a prioritized list of improvements.

description: Monthly analysis of the AIGestion codebase for technical debt and improvements
prompt: Analyze the AIGestion codebase for improvement opportunities: 1) Technical debt areas 2) Performance bottlenecks 3) Security concerns 4) Missing tests 5) Documentation gaps 6) Architecture improvements. Prioritize by impact and effort.
